name: Runway
description: Runway lets agents generate images and videos with Runway models in the account of the signed-in user. Each generation uses account credits.

prompts.text: Generate a square product image of a ceramic mug on a wooden table.
Make a 5-second video of a paper boat in the rain.
Turn this image into a short video with a slow camera pan.

apps.name: Runway
apps.description: Image and video generation, over Runway's MCP server with browser sign-in.
